MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The epoxy felt useful because it could secure a broken part when my screws and nails cannot, making it a practical next choice for small repairs.",
    "The repair tapes fit some of the same household repair needs, although the large packs kept me from choosing them now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The safety can and cutting wheels assume liquid storage or metal-cutting tasks that my recent purchases do not establish.",
    "The trash lid and shelving casters require specific equipment I have not shown I own, while the silicone sealant assumes a sealing job I do not currently have.",
    "The decorating kit felt less relevant because my recent drywall anchors already address my mounting needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Shopping for construction fasteners seems to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop or maintenance supply.",
    "A general connection to repairs seems to have outweighed whether I need the particular product and pack size right now."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated nail and screw purchases point most clearly toward fastening and mounting tasks; nearby supplies should have a concrete connection to those tasks.",
    "Quantity matters: I can find tape or glue useful and still pass because six rolls, eighteen rolls, or twelve units exceed my current needs.",
    "I would choose the epoxy for a particular repair purpose, rather than buy several different adhesives just because they all help with repairs."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but stretched them into unrelated tasks, equipment-specific accessories, and quantities I would not choose now."
}
